one_line_description: Unified spend platform with corporate cards and expense management
auth_methods_evidence: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs. All APIs accept and return JSON and require HTTPS.
self_serve_evidence: Check out our quickstart guide to get up and running making your first Brex API call in just a few minutes.
buildability_rationale: Good docs, broad API, self-serve with OAuth2 and API key options, but gating type suggests some limitations.
agent_notes: The API documentation is comprehensive and includes multiple endpoints for different aspects of the Brex platform. The Composio registry confirms the authentication methods and tools count.
